title: SG-4.2 · No tracked changes in vendored Phaser files under node_modules
summary: Keep game/frontend/node_modules (including phaser tsgen test files) out of tracked changes
description: Context: game/frontend/node_modules is committed (about 15k files, including node_modules/phaser/scripts/tsgen) and root .gitignore only ignores game/node_modules/, which is the wrong path. The git status also shows a conflicted tracked cache file game/frontend/node_modules/.vite/vitest/results.json. Desired behavior: node_modules is ignored everywhere and no node_modules path is tracked, so vendored Phaser files cannot show as modified. Why: Act steps modified vendored tsgen files, which must never appear as product changes.
acceptance_criteria: Given the repository, when .gitignore is read, then it ignores node_modules at any depth, including game/frontend/node_modules
Given the git index, when tracked paths are listed, then none contains a node_modules path segment

in_scope: a guard helper that detects tracked node_modules paths
out_of_scope: Changing phaser version or its pin
preserve: phaser ~3.90.0 pin in package.json and package-lock.json

technical_constraints: Do not edit vendored files; remove them from the index only, leaving files on disk
definition_of_done: Both requirements are met and their unit tests pass
